results.title: Facebook Is Finally Giving People A Non-Algorithmic News Feed
results.snippet: Soon, you will be able to toggle into a “Feeds” button on the top of the Facebook app so you can view posts in chronological order from either Friends, Groups, and Pages. Twitter and Instagram have also recently caved to the roaring cacophony of their users chanting, “we hate the algorithm WE HATE THE ALGORITHM.” In 2018, Twitter rolled out a little twinkle button that allows you to switch to a chronological feed.

results.title: r/LifeProTips on Reddit: LPT: if you want to view Facebook as it was pre-algorithm and just see chronological posts from your friends, go to the “Feeds” tab and select “Friends”
results.snippet: On the "default" feed its only worse because it suggests a ton of obnoxious pages, some of which are also for brands (yet somehow, not ads). The advertising is beyond excessive. Is it like this for everyone?! How does anyone have patience for this? ... Better days. A little while back I was wondering about someone I knew in college and pulled them up on Facebook, turns out their account is still up but they haven't posted anything since pre-algorithm.

results.title: How can I see a group's posts according to chronological order in Facebook (date posted)? Even the "*" search is not working.
results.snippet: Answer (1 of 2): This is now possible by changing the sorting of the group to “New Posts” (it defaults to “Recent Activity”). Alternatively, you can set the ‘sorting_setting’ parameter in your URL to ‘CHRONOLOGICAL’: [code]https://www.facebook.com/groups/YOUR_GROUP_ID/?sort...
